# Repeatable (10-year cooldown): Muster Greek Stratioti light cavalry during the Italian Wars era.
oe_itw_dec_stratioti_contract = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_itw_is_host = yes
        oe_itw_era_open = yes
        current_year <= 1580
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 75
        prestige >= 5
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_itw_stratioti_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_itw_dec_stratioti_contract.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -75
            add_prestige = -5
            set_variable = { name = oe_itw_stratioti_cd months = 120 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itw_stratioti_levy years = 10 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# One-time: Reconstitute the Exarchate of Ravenna once BYZ/ROM directly holds Ravenna, Naples, Palermo, or Rome.
oe_itw_dec_proclaim_exarchate = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_itw_is_host = yes
        oe_itw_era_open = yes
        NOT = { var:oe_itw_exarchate_done ?= 1 }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 120
        stability >= 0
        OR = {
            owns = location:ravenna
            owns = location:naples
            owns = location:palermo
            owns = location:rome
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:soldiers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_itw_dec_proclaim_exarchate.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_itw_exarchate_done value = 1 }
            add_gold = -120
            add_stability = -10
            add_prestige = 25
            oe_itw_add_inf = { amt = 3 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itw_exarchate_seat years = 30 mode = replace }
        }
    }
